notes.title: April 4th, 2019 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The game server has been rebooted to apply patches. 
If you don't see the update yet, please close and restart the Steam launcher to download the patch files. 

[h1]Update & Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the reward items on the result screen were different from the actual rewards. 
[*] Fixed the number of hits of Hummer's skill [Head Rush] (S)
[*] Added the feature [Cancel the Friend Request]
[*] Minor bug fix: in-game errors
[/list]

notes.title: FEB 18 Patch Notes: Free-to-Play!
notes.content:
[h1][b]WIDE CROSS is now Free to play, which is accessible for everyone![/b][/h1]

[b][i]Updates[/i][/b]
- Everyone now will have 10 basic playable characters, and the rest of them are purchasable in Shop with gold.
- In-app purchase via Steam Wallet will be updated soon. 
- 3vs3 Arena Rank Match has been added.
- In the Robby, players can see how many players are queued for each modes. 

 [b][i]Known Issues (will be fixed on the next patches):[/i][/b]
 - A bug where the Win/Lose records is not updating correctly on Rankings. 
 - An UI glitch after buying Heroes or items from shop.

tags.feature: - 3vs3 Arena Rank Match has been added.
- In the Robby, players can see how many players are queued for each modes.

tags.bug: - A bug where the Win/Lose records is not updating correctly on Rankings.
- An UI glitch after buying Heroes or items from shop.
